verdict.rationale: Docs confirm proxy support ("specify the proxy server details in your task parameters") and auto-CAPTCHA solving, which support anti-blocking automation, but there is no documentation of stealth/fingerprint spoofing techniques or explicitly residential/geo-targeted proxy pools — only generic proxy configuration.
